boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented CSUF study environments across Pollak Library and on-campus housing, with access details noted where the university specifies them.

cards.entity_name: Pollak Library North Third Floor Quiet Study
cards.title: Pollak Library North Third Floor Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Pollak Library North · third floor
cards.notes: Use this designated quiet floor when you need low-noise reading time; keep phones off and conversations to a minimum.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-study floor with book stacks, maps, and nearby group-study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUF identifies Pollak Library North's third floor as a Quiet Study Floor and says group study rooms are on its west side.
cards.source_title: Pollak Library Third Floor North | CSUF - Pollak Library
cards.access_notes: Quiet-study area; library guidance says to keep noise to a minimum and turn cell phones off when entering.

cards.entity_name: Pollak Library South Fourth Floor Quiet Study
cards.title: Pollak Library South Fourth Floor Quiet Study
cards.subtitle: Pollak Library South · fourth floor
cards.notes: Bring a reading-heavy task and use the quiet-floor setting; the floor also places book stacks and restrooms within reach.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet floor in Library South, alongside A–D and oversized book stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUF describes the fourth floor of Pollak Library South as a quiet study floor containing book stacks.
cards.source_title: Pollak Library Fourth Floor South | CSUF - Pollak Library
cards.access_notes: Quiet-study area; library guidance says to keep noise to a minimum and turn cell phones off when entering.

cards.entity_name: Pollak Library North First Floor Group Study Space
cards.title: Pollak Library North First Floor Group Study Space
cards.subtitle: Pollak Library North · first floor
cards.notes: Set up a discussion-based session here, then use the Information & Learning Commons services and first-floor printers as needed.
cards.short_summary: A group-study floor integrated with the Information & Learning Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUF designates the first floor of Library North for group study and lists the Information & Learning Commons and printers there.
cards.source_title: Pollak Library First Floor North | CSUF - Pollak Library
cards.access_notes: Talking and group work are permitted in the library's designated group-study areas.

cards.entity_name: Pollak Library North Second Floor Group Study Space
cards.title: Pollak Library North Second Floor Group Study Space
cards.subtitle: Pollak Library North · second floor
cards.notes: Choose this group-study floor for a project that may benefit from nearby technology, makerspace, or digital-print services.
cards.short_summary: A group-study floor with technology, makerspace, and digital-print resources nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUF designates the second floor of Library North for group study; its floor map lists the Advanced Technology Lab, Makerspace, and Digital Print Services.
cards.source_title: Pollak Library Second Floor North | CSUF - Pollak Library
cards.access_notes: Talking and group work are permitted in the library's designated group-study areas.

cards.entity_name: Pollak Library North Fourth Floor Group Study Space
cards.title: Pollak Library North Fourth Floor Group Study Space
cards.subtitle: Pollak Library North · fourth floor
cards.notes: Use this floor for collaborative coursework and locate an open group-study room; printers and book stacks are on the same level.
cards.short_summary: A group-study floor with rooms on both sides and research collections close by.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUF lists Pollak Library North's fourth floor as containing study spaces and group study rooms on both sides of the floor.
cards.source_title: Pollak Library Fourth Floor North | CSUF - Pollak Library
cards.access_notes: Talking and group work are permitted in the library's designated group-study areas.

cards.entity_name: Pollak Library South Fifth Floor Group Study Space
cards.title: Pollak Library South Fifth Floor Group Study Space
cards.subtitle: Pollak Library South · fifth floor
cards.notes: Plan a collaborative work block here and use the floor's book stacks for quick source checks between discussion and drafting.
cards.short_summary: A Library South study floor designated for group work, with E–G and M–N stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUF designates Pollak Library South's fifth floor as group study space and identifies it as a study floor containing book stacks.
cards.source_title: Pollak Library Fifth Floor South | CSUF - Pollak Library
cards.access_notes: Talking and group work are permitted in the library's designated group-study areas.

cards.title: Pollak Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Pollak Library · reservation-based rooms
cards.notes: Reserve for a focused group session; arrive with your confirmation number and keep the work academic and study-related.
cards.short_summary: Bookable rooms for collaborative academic work in Pollak Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Pollak Library offers group study rooms and limits reservations to currently enrolled CSUF students, faculty, and staff.
cards.access_notes: Reservations are two hours or until closing, whichever is shorter; groups of two or more require a second CWID.

cards.entity_name: Pollak Library Smart Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Pollak Library Smart Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Pollak Library North · first floor
cards.notes: Look for these first-floor rooms when your group wants a defined workspace near the Information & Learning Commons.
cards.short_summary: Named smart group-study rooms on Library North's first floor.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUF's first-floor Library North map lists Smart Group Study Rooms alongside the Information & Learning Commons.
cards.source_title: Pollak Library First Floor North | CSUF - Pollak Library
cards.access_notes: For library study-room use, CSUF states that reservations are limited to currently enrolled students, faculty, and staff.

cards.title: Collab Space PLN 436
cards.subtitle: Pollak Library North · room 436
cards.notes: Head to room 436 for collaborative coursework, and use the fourth-floor printers or nearby group-study rooms when needed.
cards.short_summary: A named collaboration space on the fourth floor of Library North.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUF's fourth-floor Library North map identifies Collab Space PLN 436 among the floor's study spaces.
cards.source_title: Pollak Library Fourth Floor North | CSUF - Pollak Library
cards.access_notes: Located on Pollak Library North's fourth floor; consult the library floor map for orientation.

cards.title: Pine Academic Resource Center
cards.subtitle: Pine Residence Hall · first floor
cards.notes: Residents can use the quiet study area, whiteboards, seating, computers, printing, and tutoring connections during posted hours.
cards.short_summary: A resident-focused academic space with quiet study features and support services.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUF says PARC is on Pine's first floor, available to residents, and provides quiet study space, whiteboards, seating, free printing, and tutoring connections.
cards.source_title: Pine Academic Resource Center | CSUF - Housing and Residential Engagement
cards.access_notes: Available to on-campus residents. Posted hours: Sun 10 a.m.–10 p.m.; Mon/Wed 8 a.m.–12 p.m. and 2–10 p.m.; Tue/Thu 8 a.m.–10 p.m.; Fri 8 a.m.–4 p.m.; Sat closed.
